This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, Chester Morris as Boston Blackie battling wartime gas counterfeiters for Rinso, E.G. Marshall & Norman Rose on Himan Brown's *CBS Radio Mystery Theater*, J. Edgar Hoover endorsed cases on *This Is Your FBI*, two thrilling episodes of *High Adventure*, and early Perry Como vocals with Ted Weems on *Beat The Band* for Kix (1940–1998):
